purpose: Capture historically documented PQ reward-to-skill relationships while preserving uncertainty about exact reward triggers and conflicting numbering.

evidence: Steam Community Guide: DBX2 Parallel Quest Item / Skill Rewards, published November 8, 2016
research_rules: A reward listing is not automatically a guaranteed reward or an Ultimate Finish requirement.
Enemy-specific acquisition is only promoted where a source explicitly connects the skill to an enemy; otherwise the route remains unknown.
Numerical drop rates are not inferred from farming reports.
Historical PQ numbering conflicts remain explicit until reconciled.
This file is an evidence layer and does not replace canonical skill identity data.
